description.zh: 模板执行后的回调。
description.en: The callback URL that is used after the template is executed.

description.zh: 模板描述。
description.en: The description of the template.

description.zh:
存储文件格式，多值用逗号分隔。取值：
- mp4
- flv
- hls
> 青岛单元暂不支持flv、mp4录制
description.en:
The file format for storage. Separate multiple values with commas. Valid values:

- mp4

- flv

- hls

> Recording in FLV and MP4 formats is not supported in the China (Qingdao) region.

description.zh: FLV的存储路径。格式参考Mp4说明。
description.en: The storage path for FLV files. For information about the format, see the description of the Mp4 parameter.

description.zh: HLS的存储路径，m3u8文件。格式参考Mp4说明。
description.en: The storage path for HLS M3U8 files. For information about the format, see the description of the Mp4 parameter.

The storage path for HLS TS files.

- The path supports variables such as {AppName}, {StreamName}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence}.

- You must include the {UnixTimestamp} and {Sequence} variables.

description.zh: 模板ID。
description.en: The ID of the template.

description.zh: 操作周期，单位秒。
description.en: The operation interval, in seconds.

description.zh:
JPG的存储路径，用于按需截图。
- 目前仅支持生成jpg图片。
- 支持变量匹配，包含{AppName}、{StreamName}、{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}
- {UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}必填一个
description.en:
The storage path for JPG files. This path is used for on-demand snapshots.

- Only JPG images are supported.

- The path supports variables such as {AppName}, {StreamName}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence}.

- You must include either {UnixTimestamp} or {Sequence}.

The storage path for JPG files. This path is used to overwrite snapshots.

- Only JPG images are supported.

- The path supports variables such as {AppName} and {StreamName}.

description.zh:
JPG的存储路径，用于序列截图。
- 目前仅支持生成jpg图片。
- 支持变量匹配，包含{AppName}、{StreamName}、{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}
- {UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}必填一个
description.en:
The storage path for JPG files. This path is used for sequence snapshots.

- Only JPG images are supported.

- The path supports variables such as {AppName}, {StreamName}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence}.

- You must include either {UnixTimestamp} or {Sequence}.

The storage path for MP4 files.

- The path supports variables such as {AppName}, {StreamName}, {Sequence}, {EscapedStartTime}, and {EscapedEndTime}.

- You must include {EscapedStartTime} and {EscapedEndTime}.

description.zh: 模板名称。
description.en: The name of the template.

description.zh: OSS的Bucket。
description.en: The OSS bucket.

description.zh: OSS的域名。
description.en: The domain name of the OSS bucket.

description.zh: OSS文件前缀
description.en: The prefix of the OSS file.

description.zh: OSS所属区域，即服务中心。
description.en: The region where the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket is located.

description.zh: 时移保存周期，单位：天
description.en: The retention period for time shifting, in days.

description.zh: 转码配置TransConfig类型的数组，JSON格式字符串
description.en: An array of transcoding configurations of the TransConfig type, in a JSON-formatted string.

description.zh:
模板触发类型，默认auto。取值：
- auto（自动）
- ondemand（按需）
description.en:
The trigger type of the template. The default value is auto. Valid values:

- auto (automatic)

- ondemand (on-demand)
